purpose: Teach: 滑走/注入/征服/履修/標高/図形/代謝/点滴

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、空港の滑走路設計の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I see you wrote your paper on airport runway design.
lines.style: Steady, observational opening. Gentle confirmation tone. Teacher-to-student rapport. Slight upward inflection at the end, inviting him to expand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、燃料の注入工程の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I did my research on fuel injection processes.
lines.style: Quiet, direct affirmation. Small pause before the key detail. Respectful, earnest—slightly uncertain but standing by the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代における植民地の征服史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered the history of colonial conquest in the modern period?
lines.style: Softer, more reflective. Slower pace. Genuine curiosity underneath—checking her understanding with warmth, not skepticism.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、学部の履修制度の改革を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on departmental curriculum reform systems.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not defensive. Clear but careful. Respectful pause before redirecting. Earnest throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 高地の標高別生態系の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The alpine ecosystem research—by elevation zones, yes?
lines.style: Engaged and present. Warm recognition in the voice. Leaning into the detail. Expecting him to meet her there.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、数学教育における図形指導を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I wrote about geometric instruction in mathematics education.
lines.style: Quiet but steady clarification. Respectful, not frustrated by the redirect. Simple honesty. Slight pause between thought and response.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新陳代謝の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your paper dealt with metabolism?
lines.style: Reflective, careful phrasing. Slower, almost musing. Giving him the chance to complete the picture. Warm invitation to clarify.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、点滴投与の医療史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, it was the medical history of intravenous drip therapy.
lines.style: Final correction, delivered gently but with quiet finality. Honest and direct. A small breath before the key term. Respectful closure.
